sentences.text: ?Court No. - 86
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 36619 of 2022

Applicant :- Amit Alias Paye
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others

Counsel for Applicant :- Avadh Raj Sharma
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Mayank Kumar Jain,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

The present bail application has been filed on behalf of applicant in Case Crime No.131 of 2020,
under Sections 363, 366, 368, 376 IPC and under section 3/4 Protection of Children from Sexual Offence Act, Police Station Barla, District Aligarh with the prayer to enlarge the applicant on bail.
It is argued by the learned counsel for the applicant that applicant is innocent and he has been falsely implicated in the present case.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offence Act
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: First information report was lodged after five days of the incident and no plausible explanation is offered.

In her statement under section 161 and 164 Cr. P.C.
the victim has stated that she went with the applicant at her own accord and she performed marriage with the applicant in New Delhi and they are living together.
Co-accused Hajari Lal has already been granted bail vide order dated11.04.2022 in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 15091 of 2022.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 15091 of 2022
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: Victim has refused to under go for medical examination.
He further argued that victim in her statement under section 161/164 Cr. P.C. has narrated her age to be 18-19 years.
It is further argued that no allegation has been made against the applicant by the victim as described in her statement under section 161 Cr. P.C. It is further submitted

that applicant is languishing in jail since Amit Alias Paye vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 20 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/40390089/
1 08.04.2022 having no criminal history and that in case he is released on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail and will cooperate in trial.

entities.text: Amit Alias Paye vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Per contra, the learned Additional Government Advocate has opposed the prayer for grant of bail.

Be that as it may, though there is on record the educational certificate of the victim of Class-5 indicating the date of birth of victim is 12.03.2004 but that should not be conclusive at this stage in the absence of any proof regarding genuineness of the educational certificate produced on record.

Considering the entire facts and circumstances of the case, submissions of learned counsel for the parties, nature of evidence and all attending facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on merits of the case, the Court is of the view that the applicant has made out a case for bail.
The bail application is allowed.

Let the applicant Amit Alias Paye in the aforesaid crime be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties to the satisfaction of court concerned subject to the following conditions:
(1). The applicant will not tamper with the prosecution evidence during the trial.
(2). The applicant will not influence any witness.
(3). The applicant will appear before the trial Court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.

(4). The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution shall be at liberty to move an application before this Court seeking cancellation of the bail.
